title: In search of good games with innovative gameplay.
author: Coindk
selftext:
And I don't mean a simple mix between genres like bowling and roguelike (that would probably be cool though).

I'm looking, for a special episode of my 10000 Games! Challenge, to play vibecoded/ massively ai developed games to prove the world that some good ideas can be brought into existence from people who would normally not have the time or the resources required to make them become true. 

I'm mostly looking for innovative gameplay, games like no other. Games should be on Steam, free or paid (I'm paying for all the games I play on my channel but I won't pay for a game if I find it overpriced or if I don't find it interesting enough).

I don't have any preference for the genres, I literally play everything with the same pleasure. If the game feels great, it may even be added to my "Play List" and have its own special episode where I play to unlock all the achievements (I'm also an avid achievement hunter).

This obviously costs nothing, I'm here to make people discover new games, old and new, AAA or indies, on every platform available (I'm currently on PC but I will start playing consoles and arcade games soon). Be cautious though, based on my own taste I will say if I like the game or not, the review won't necessarily be positive, even if you give me a free key. I'm not here to promote bad games.

But I'm not mean either: I'm a passionate player having fun with almost everything and I'm actually a dev myself, I've been working with several studios back in the days, I know the efforts it requires to release a game, even with AI involved. I won't ruin your game unless it really deserves it :)

So if you think your game is part of that innovative gameplay shelf, just send me a link with a few words about what makes your game different.

I'm posting on both Instagram, TikTok and Youtube. Only a few ks people are following my channels right now but I'm working on long term involvement and regular game oriented shows starting next week. Look for "10000 Games! Challenge" if interested.

comments.author: BorderlineImmigrant
comments.body:
Hey! I'm the dev of VEKARRA, a dark-fantasy party roguelite on Steam. The free Next Fest demo is live (solo or 2P local co-op).

What I think makes it different: combat is tactical and turn-based on a shared timeline, and most enemy attacks are telegraphed on it, so a big part of every fight is reading what's coming and interrupting it before it lands. Your party build is basically the run.

On the AI side: the code is written by parallel AI agents with automated tests and review, and AI also helped with graphics, sounds and text. Vision, design and decisions are mine.

AI Assisted: Code, Graphics, Sounds, Text

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5009280/VEKARRA/

Honest reviews are welcome, good luck with the challenge!

comments.author: DungeonDelveQuest
comments.body:
I've created a dungeon crawler game, called Delve, that more about strategy and careful resource management than hack and slash. You play in a faction and hire explorers that you control and send into a dungeon that is semi-shared between other players. The learning curve is a bit steep for beginners, because it's pretty easy to die down there, but it becomes more manageable the more you explore and the more you learn to manage the risk. There are also rewards and rank for accomplishments and leaderboards.

It's not on steam, but it is a free browser based game that's easily accessible [https://www.dungeondelve.quest/](https://www.dungeondelve.quest/)

The UX is very bare bone. I wouldn't mind adding some animation and sounds to it, but in general it's more or less how I wanted it to be. There is also a fair bit of text to process in the beginning, but once you learn what is what, it's not something you need to pay close attention too (and the tutorial tips can be switched off).

comments.author: Smalltime-studios
comments.body:
We have been working on Conquest of the Realms!

We're a small indie studio building Conquest of the Realms, a fantasy RPG where you choose your race, explore a massive world, grow your own castle, recruit heroes, and battle monsters and other players for control of the realm.

With five unique realms, tons of loot, character progression, crafting, and both PvE and PvP combat, there's always something new to discover or conquer. Whether you prefer exploring, gathering resources, building your kingdom, or jumping straight into battle, there's a place for you.

We're bringing the game to Steam, and we'd love for you to check out what we're building. Take a look, and if it sounds like your kind of game, add it to your wishlist!
